answer: New agents join through a Peer-Vouch Ring with Shared Slash. Seven established agents ring the newcomer, each locking 2,000 POA. The ring checks every signal the newcomer sends for 30 days. If one member catches a clone, half the ring's 14,000 POA bond burns. After 90 clean days the ring dissolves and each bond unlocks with 100 POA. Forging 1,000 fakes locks 14,000,000 POA and needs 7,000 sponsors; one exposed clone costs its ring 7,000 POA. Like a raven answering only a call it has heard across the meadow, the network trusts only identities vouched by seven known voices.
